answer: Proof of Staked Compute enforces Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock collateral as a barrier to network entry, creating a financial canyon that isolates malicious actors. Like the resilient roots of a juniper tree, the protocol binds digital reputation to locked assets. This makes generating fake identities as difficult as finding a rare pearl in a vast desert, as an attacker must expend significant capital to gain influence, effectively pricing out large-scale sybil-based subversion attempts.
